NAME: Clock divider and reset controller verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-CLKRST-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Divide the external 500 MHz reference to 250 MHz hclk.
details: Divide the external 500 MHz reference to 250 MHz hclk.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0001

NAME: t_clk_div2
details: Oracle: hclk period = 2× refclk, duty 50% ±2%
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check named t_clk_div2 - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 Provide 125 MHz pclk for the APB peripherals 50 duty.
details: Provide 125 MHz pclk for the APB peripherals, 50% duty.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0002

NAME: t_pclk_div2
details: Oracle: pclk period = 2× hclk, duty 50% ±2%
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check named t_pclk_div2 - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 The divide ratio shall be a parameter so a timing miss is ...
details: The divide ratio shall be a parameter, so a timing miss is recoverable without redesign.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0001

NAME: t_div_sel
details: Oracle: each DIVSEL value gives the right ratio Coverage goal: all 4 values
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks named t_div_sel, all 12 ordered transitions of the 4 DIVSEL values - 12 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_div_switch_glitch
details: Oracle: a_div_no_glitch holds across all 12 ratio transitions Coverage goal: all ordered pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check named t_div_switch_glitch (shortest hclk phase >= 2 ns across the transitions) - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-4 Reset shall not depend on any analog cell inside the chip ...
details: Reset shall not depend on any analog cell inside the chip. ext_rst_n is the only power-on reset source, driven by a board supervisor that holds it low until the core supply is stable.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0019

NAME: t_no_por
details: Oracle: chip resets correctly with ext_rst_n as the only source
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c (every chip test uses ext_rst_n but none checks that it is the only source).

NAME: R-5 Every reset assertion shall last at least 1024 reference cycles ...
details: Every reset assertion shall last at least 1024 reference cycles at the point of use.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0003

NAME: t_reset_stretch
details: Oracle: every reset ≥1024 refclk cycles Coverage goal: all 4 sources
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks named t_reset_stretch for power-on and SWRST - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The WDT reset length is checked by t_wdt_self_cancel; the NDM source is not measured.

NAME: t_wdt_self_cancel
details: Oracle: watchdog single-cycle pulse → full-length reset
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check named t_wdt_self_cancel (1-cycle pulse gives a 4103 ns reset) - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Chip-level confirmation: sw/chip/t_chip_wdt.c RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: R-6 No block shall be able to reset the logic that generates its own ...
details: No block shall be able to reset the logic that generates its own reset request.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0003

NAME: t_reset_domains
details: Oracle: each source's excluded blocks are not reset Coverage goal: all 4 sources
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check named t_reset_domains (watchdog request domain not reset by WDT) - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Only the WDT source is checked, not all 4.

NAME: R-7 Reset release shall be synchronous to the clock of the domain ...
details: Reset release shall be synchronous to the clock of the domain being released.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0003

NAME: t_sync_release
details: Oracle: no flop in a domain leaves reset on a different cycle
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c, sw/chip/t_chip_wdt.c.

NAME: R-8 The cause of the last reset shall be readable by firmware after ...
details: The cause of the last reset shall be readable by firmware after that reset.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0003

NAME: t_rst_reason
details: Oracle: correct bit after each reset type; W1C works Coverage goal: all 5 bits
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks named t_rst_reason (EXT, SW, WDT, NDM) plus SETBOOTFAIL and W1C clear - 6 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Chip-level: sw/chip/t_chip_wdt.c RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: R-9 A debug-initiated reset shall not reset the Debug Module or the ...
details: A debug-initiated reset shall not reset the Debug Module or the JTAG TAP.
implementation_note: Source: RISC-V Debug 0.13 §3.2

NAME: t_ndmreset_dm_alive
details: Oracle: DM and TAP respond during and after ndmreset
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks named t_ndmreset_dm_alive and 'DM never reset across ndmreset' - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-10 500 MHz shall exist on no net other than the pad-to-divider ...
details: 500 MHz shall exist on no net other than the pad-to-divider connection.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0018

NAME: planned test
details: Oracle: not simulation-verifiable; checked at floorplan review
implementation_note: Status in the specification: PD gate. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - not simulation-verifiable (floorplan review); nothing in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_no_cdc_proof
details: Oracle: a_pclk_subset_hclk + a_pclk_phase over 10⁶ cycles
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks named t_no_cdc_proof and a_pclk_phase (0 violations) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The run length in cycles is not stated in the log.

NAME: t_hartreset
details: Oracle: core resets, fabric stays alive, SBA still works
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks named t_hartreset and 'hartreset release is immediate' - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_reset_release_order
details: Oracle: refclk → hclk → pclk ordering
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check named t_reset_release_order - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_reset_min_duration
details: reset duration: the property the stretch counter exists to guarantee
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_reset_stretch).

NAME: a_wdt_req_survives_reset
details: no reset source resets its own requester (R-6)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_reset_domains).

NAME: a_reason_survives_wdt
details: reason register survives every reset except external
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_rst_reason: WDT) and sw/chip/t_chip_wdt.c.

NAME: a_reason_onehot
details: exactly one cause bit set per reset event
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_rst_reason compares the whole register for equality).

NAME: a_sync_release_hclk
details: synchronous release: reset deasserts only on a clock edge
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only.

NAME: a_pclk_subset_hclk
details: pclk edges are a subset of hclk edges (the no-CDC argument, checked)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_no_cdc_proof).

NAME: a_pclk_phase
details: pclk_phase leads each pclk rising edge by exactly one hclk cycle
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (a_pclk_phase).

NAME: a_pclk_ratio
details: pclk is always exactly half of hclk
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_pclk_div2).

NAME: a_div_no_glitch
details: glitch-free ratio change: no short pulse during DIVBUSY
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_div_switch_glitch).

NAME: a_release_order
details: preset_n never deasserts before hreset_n (release order, N-7.17)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_reset_release_order).

NAME: a_hartreset_scope
details: hartreset resets the core without touching the fabric
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_hartreset).
